description: Composes staged instructions for turning reviewed Open Design artifacts into a reusable component set on a named React library: Material UI themed to Material 3 (`mui`), shadcn/ui (`shadcn`), or React Native components styled with NativeWind for Expo apps (`nativewind`). Use it when the user asks for components, a component library or a component set from a design ("make Material 3 components for my React app from this"); for putting one page into the app, use port_open_design_artifact_to_app instead. Returns a repeated-element inventory to turn into components.md (then stop for the user's approval), a ready theme generated from the design system's tokens, component and gallery rules, and how to record the set. Does NOT write app code. Call it again with `record` after the set builds: that writes metadata.componentLibrary on the artifacts' manifests so a later run updates the same set.

collectionId.description: Instead of entryPaths: every screen of this collection.

entryPaths.description: Workspace-relative entry paths of 1 to 10 registered artifacts the set is built from.

library.description: "mui" (Material UI, themed to Material 3), "shadcn" (shadcn/ui), "nativewind" (React Native components styled with NativeWind, for Expo and React Native apps), or "auto" (default) to pick from the app's package.json (an Expo or React Native app always gets "nativewind").

outputDir.description: Optional: workspace-relative folder for the components, inside the app. Default: <app>/src/components/<DesignName>, or the folder an earlier record names.

record.description: Stage 5 only: the finished set, written to the artifacts' manifests instead of returning instructions.

name: prepare_open_design_component_library
title: Prepare a component library
